 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The New Orleans Pelicans are at home Saturday night as they host the Denver Nuggets in a Western Conference matchup.
 New Orleans enters Saturday's game with a 4-9 record after losing at home to the Memphis Grizzlies Friday night.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement New Orleans Pelicans forward Saddiq Bey (41)Petre Thomas - Imagn Images
 In Friday's loss, Saddiq Bey led the way for the Pelicans as he recorded 30 points and 10 rebounds while Zion Williamson added 22 points, five rebounds, four assists and three steals of his own.
 The Pelicans will try to bounce back Saturday as they face off against the Nuggets in a tough home matchup.
 Denver enters Saturday's contest with a 6-4 record after defeating the Grizzlies on the road Wednesday night.
 Denver Nuggets stars Nikola Jokic and Jamal MurrayRon Chenoy-Imagn Images
 Nikola Jokic led the way for the Nuggets in Wednesday's victory as he ended the game with 27 points, 11 rebounds and eight assists while Jamal Murray recorded 30 points, four rebounds and eight assists.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement While both teams are looking to pick up a victory in Saturday night's matchup, one may be without multiple key players due to injuries.
 Nuggets Injury Report
 The Nuggets have only one player listed on their injury report as they have ruled out Julian Strawther as he remains sidelined to begin the season while recovering from a left knee sprain.
 Pelicans Injury Report: Will Trey Murphy III, Dejounte Murray Play?
 New Orleans Pelicans forward Trey Murphy III (25)Rob Gray-Imagn Images
 The Pelicans have five players listed on their injury report , including Trey Murphy III and Dejounte Murray.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement New Orleans has ruled out Murphy III due to bilateral patellar tendinopathy as he will miss his fourth consecutive contest.
 With Murphy III sidelined, Bey, Herbert Jones and Karlo Matkovic could all continue to have larger roles.
 The Pelicans have also ruled out Murray due to a left ankle sprain as he will miss his second straight game and he may not play another game for New Orleans after ESPN's Shams Charania reported Friday that the veteran guard has requested a trade.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Trendon Watford has also been ruled out due to a right ankle sprain while Bryce McGowens is sidelined with a left elbow infection.
 Yves Missi has been listed as probable and he is expected to return after being sidelined since Oct. 24 with a left knee contusion and bone bruise.
 Fans can catch Saturday night's matchup between the Nuggets and Pelicans from the Smoothie King Center at 7 p.m. ET.
